rules.status: Staff app is a PWA; integrations limited to outbound webhooks (clinozy-be README). No native iOS/Android or white-label patient app.

Offers/packages exist (Offerings room) and a 'marketing' patient consent exists; no loyalty points and no campaign delivery yet. WhatsApp/Instagram delivery is designed but not wired: messages queue in an outbox and the messaging service URL is 'reserved, nothing reads it yet' (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258-268). Today staff reply through wa.me click-to-chat links.
No public booking page, consumer app or teleconsult found in clinozy-fe/clinozy-be (grep: online booking, teleconsult = 0 hits).

Task kind 'aftercare' exists (clinozy-be/src/domains/app/sub-domains/tasks/tasks.constants.ts:26) and 'Let Clinozy handle' can queue it, but no delivery yet. WhatsApp/Instagram delivery is designed but not wired: messages queue in an outbox and the messaging service URL is 'reserved, nothing reads it yet' (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258-268). Today staff reply through wa.me click-to-chat links.
Patient consents are already split into data / photos / marketing (clinozy-fe/src/shared/api/app/patients-contracts.ts:75).
Pending credits exist in the Payments ledger (clinozy-fe/src/shared/components/LedgerCells/ledger-cells.ts); no patient wallet, stored credit or rewards.
'no_show' appointment status exists, but no deposit, card-on-file or cancellation-fee logic (grep 'deposit' = 0 hits).
Outbound webhooks and an optional MCP server exist (clinozy-be README); no documented public API for clinics. Discounts exist via Offers.
AI features are reserved but not built (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258).
Staff use the PWA on phones (52px mobile pills in Patients); no patient app.
No Tally export found (only unrelated 'tally' word hits). CSV export exists.
Clinozy is derma/hair/aesthetic-specific by design (rooms for machines, sessions, photos), but has no specialty template builder.
No patient-facing app or PHR.
No client portal or recurring memberships (grep 'membership plan' = 0 hits; 'membership' in code means staff memberships).
Stock room shows level and runway, but no AI reorder or supplier ordering.

Task kinds 'confirm' and 'gone_quiet' plus 'Let Clinozy handle' cover reminders, but delivery is not wired. WhatsApp/Instagram delivery is designed but not wired: messages queue in an outbox and the messaging service URL is 'reserved, nothing reads it yet' (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258-268). Today staff reply through wa.me click-to-chat links.

The patient's plan already exists: suggested offerings with quantity, price and status (clinozy-be/src/domains/app/sub-domains/patients/patient-offering-suggestions). What is missing is a quotation the patient receives and accepts.
Three data consents exist (data/photos/marketing), but no procedure-specific e-consent forms with signature. Signed consent documents can be uploaded as patient reports.
Lab, scan and consent documents can be uploaded to the patient file, up to 10 per patient (patients/patient-reports). There is no lab ordering or lab partner integration.
Before/after photos exist; no AI image analysis.
No ABDM/ABHA integration (1 incidental hit).
Pre-launch: no published outcome metrics yet.
Automation is task-rule based; no conversational bot or auto-reply (grep chatbot/auto-reply = 0).
No telephony: dialer, call recording or missed-call capture.
UPI exists only as a payment mode on the ledger (clinozy-be/.../payments.constants.ts:56); no payment links. Stripe is for Clinozy's own SaaS billing.

Contacts store Instagram handles and Instagram is a lead source; Instagram DM delivery is in the outbox design but not wired. WhatsApp/Instagram delivery is designed but not wired: messages queue in an outbox and the messaging service URL is 'reserved, nothing reads it yet' (clinozy-be/src/shared/config/env-schema.ts:258-268). Today staff reply through wa.me click-to-chat links.
